# Eden AI

Use `edenai/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "edenai-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "edenai/amazon/amazon.nova-lite-v1:0",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `EDENAI_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://api.edenai.run/v3`

You can override the base URL by setting `EDENAI_BASE_URL`.

## Provider docs

- https://docs.edenai.co
